title: Tropical Biology (Summer)
about: The Organization for Tropical Studies' four-week Tropical Biology summer course for undergraduates runs July 1-31, 2027 in Costa Rica. Applications for Summer 2027 are open; the deadline is April 1, 2027.
requirements: Undergraduate in good standing at home institution
About one year (two semesters) of college-level biology or related coursework by the course start
